verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe handing tasks to the agent in natural language to implement features and fix bugs: Plan Mode for scoping bigger work, a flow to reproduce issues, find the root cause and verify fixes, and cloud agents that build, test and demo features end to end. Coordinated multi-file and multi-repo edits are also documented, including an example change applied across a whole project and scenarios where a Linear ticket or Sentry error kicks off an implementation or fix. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that multi-file implementation from plain-language prompts works as claimed.
